mentions.name: Envelope
mentions.description: This budgeting app comes with a built-in checking account and debit cards, and because the budget can actually decline card transactions it serves as an effective system for stopping overspending.
mentions.problem: Overspending; traditional budgets cannot stop transactions, whereas this app's budget can decline card transactions.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on Envelope. https://envelopebudgeting.com It’s a budgeting app that comes with a built in checking account and debit cards. Because your budget can actually decline card transactions it’s a very effective system for stopping overspending.
mentions.author: joshuakcockrell
